question:
Which two numbers (not digits) need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

​15 × 6 + 25 - 30 ÷ 5 = 95
solution:
**BODMAS rule:-**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

Option 1) 25 and 6

After interchange the numbers we get:

⇒ 15 × 25 + 6 - __**30 ÷ 5**__ = 95

⇒ __**15 × 25**__ + 6 - 6 = 95

⇒ __**375 + 6 **__- 6 = 95

⇒ __**381 - 6 **__= 95

⇒ 375 ≠ 95
